# New Drug Loft

> > A Brooklyn-based 503A/503B compounding pharmacy network providing customized medications for prescribers and patients across multiple medical specialties.

New Drug Loft and VLS Pharmacy operate a compounding pharmacy network specializing in sterile and non-sterile pharmaceutical compounding. They serve prescribers and patients with personalized medication solutions including BHRT, dermatology, pain management, and specialty treatments, maintaining USP <797> and <795> compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- Compounding pharmacy
- 503A and 503B compliance
- Sterile compounding
- Bioidentical hormone replacement therapy (BHRT)
- Dermatology compounding
- Custom medications
- USP <797> and <795> standards
- Prescriber services
- Drug shortages
- FDA regulations
- Chemical peels
- Hair loss treatments
- Erectile dysfunction therapy
- Personalized medicine
- Quality assurance

## Core Services & Specialties

- [Homepage](https://newdrugloft.com): Main entry point for New Drug Loft and VLS Pharmacy compounding network
- [Prescriber Portal](https://newdrugloft.com/prescribers): Main prescriber portal for custom compounded medications
- [Patient Portal](https://newdrugloft.com/patients): Patient portal for custom compounded medications
- [Our Medical Specialties](https://newdrugloft.com/our-specialties): Overview of medical specialties: BHRT, pain, dermatology, ophthalmics
- [Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy (BHRT)](https://newdrugloft.com/our-specialties/bhrt): BHRT compounding for testosterone, estrogen, thyroid and adrenal health
- [Dermatology Compounding](https://newdrugloft.com/our-specialties/dermatology): Dermatology compounding for acne, psoriasis, eczema and rosacea
- [Chemical Peels](https://newdrugloft.com/chemical-peels): Pharmacist-compounded chemical peels with TCA, glycolic and salicylic acid
- [Hair Loss & Dermatology Compounding](https://newdrugloft.com/dermatology-hair-loss-compounding): Hair loss and dermatology sterile compounding with minoxidil and finasteride
- [BiMix for Erectile Dysfunction](https://newdrugloft.com/our-specialties/bimix-for-erectile-dysfunction): BiMix penile injection compounding for erectile dysfunction treatment

- [New Prescriber Account Registration](https://newdrugloft.com/new-prescriber-account): Prescriber registration form with NPI and DEA credentials
